items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The mention of 'Chiles' is made by the Interviewer, not the Interviewee. The Interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or confirmation of a relationship in the provided text.

ctx.x: What year was this? Do you remember, Babe?

This had to be I'd say around '42, '43 because so many things went together because within that time, if I'm not mistaken, this came up and then Grossingers. Grossings was '45. And then right behind that we did some more college dates and then Joe went back to try to form his own little group again. And then Chiles came in there.
